page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance within the ecs.s2 server family. It is configured with 2 vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores, utilizing a dedicated CPU allocation model with 1.0 thread per core. The instance is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor.

This server configuration does not include bundled local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external block storage volumes. It features zero GPU accelerators and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, making it suitable for secure internal network deployments.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU resources, the ecs.s2.large offers a predictable compute profile for entry-level workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that performance is not subject to the resource contention common in shared-core environments, making it a cost-efficient option for lightweight application hosting, small-scale web serving, microservices, and basic development or testing environments.
